title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Advancing Harmful Content Understanding via Perception-Aware Adversarial Self-Play
abstract: arXiv:2610.15449v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite significant advances in language understanding, Large Language Models (LLMs) can still miss meaning hidden in plain sight, failing to identify harmful intent in expressions readily understood by humans. Malicious users exploit this gap by strategically disguising harmful content to evade automated moderation, posing a serious threat to online platform safety. The vulnerability reflects a fundamental cognitive asymmetry between human readers, who integrate contextual, phonetic, and visual cues to decipher the intent behind deliberate obfuscation, and text-based LLMs, which rely primarily on token sequences and have limited exposure to evolving evasions. To bridge this asymmetry, we propose PASP (Perception-Aware Adversarial Self-Play), which combines multi-perceptual views with adversarial self-play to improve understanding of harmful intent as evasions evolve. translated_title: 藏于明处：通过感知感知式对抗自博弈（PASP）提升有害内容理解能力
translated_abstract: 尽管在语言理解方面取得了显著进展，大型语言模型（LLM）仍可能忽略“藏于明处”的含义，无法识别人类轻易就能理解的表达中所蕴含的有害意图。恶意用户利用这一缺口，策略性地伪装有害内容以规避自动化内容审核，对在线平台安全构成严重威胁。这种脆弱性反映了人类读者与基于文本的LLM之间的根本性认知不对称：人类读者能够综合上下文、语音和视觉等多种线索来破解刻意混淆背后的意图，而基于文本的LLM主要依赖词元序列，且对不断演化的规避手段接触有限。为了弥合这种不对称，我们提出了PASP（感知感知式对抗自博弈），该方法将多感知视角与对抗性自博弈相结合，在规避手段不断演化的情况下提升对有害意图的理解。具体而言，PASP构建了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出PASP框架，通过融合文本、语音、视觉等多感知视角与对抗性自博弈机制，弥合人类读者与LLM之间的认知不对称，从而提升模型对不断演化的伪装性有害内容意图的理解能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes PASP, a perception-aware adversarial self-play framework that integrates textual, phonetic, and visual views with adversarial self-play to bridge the cognitive asymmetry between humans and LLMs, improving understanding of evolving disguised harmful intent.
